ios.desc:
Improve your typing speed, accuracy, and technique with a powerful typing test and trainer built around a clean, distraction-free experience. Upgrade to Pro for extra challenges, stats, themes and unlimited custom text.

Key Features:

Typing Speed Test:
• Timer-Based Session.
• Word Count-Based Session.

Lessons Practice Mode:
• Structured Learning: Improve your typing with guided lessons covering the home, top, bottom, symbol, and number keys.
• Progress Tracking: Monitor accuracy, WPM, and high scores for each lesson.

N-Gram Word Focus Lab:
• Precision Training: Build fluid muscle memory by focusing on "sticky" character sequences (N-Grams) that cause frequent mistakes.
• Intelligent Drill Logic: Use Targeted (PRO), Smart Mix (PRO), or Expansion strategies to eliminate accuracy gaps and master challenging patterns.

On-Device AI Text Generator & Typing Insights (Requires iOS 26 & Apple Intelligence Enabled)
• Infinite Content: Instantly generate unique practice passages from various topics and supported languages.
• Typing Insights: Receive on-device AI analysis of speed, with deeper accuracy and consistency insights in Pro.
• Privacy First: All AI generation and analysis run locally on-device with zero data collection.

Detailed Typing Analytics:
• Performance Metrics: Calculates WPM (Net & Gross), Accuracy, and Consistency.
• Error Tracking: Tracks correct, incorrect, and missed characters.
• Level Progression: Earn XP from each typing session and unlock new levels.
• WPM Graph: Track your progress across sessions.
• Mistyped Keys & N-Gram Analysis: View key-error heatmaps and missing bigram/trigram patterns to target weaknesses.
• Key Latency & Bottlenecks: Measure delays across keys, bigrams, and trigrams to pinpoint hesitation patterns.

Typing Replays & Ghost Practice:
• Live Playback: Replay typing sessions as they happened.
• Free Replay Library: Save favorite sessions.
• Replay Sharing: Export and share replay files—free for everyone.
• Ghost Practice: Type alongside past runs in timed or word mode.
• Versus Races: Race CPUs or compatible recordings in Ghost Race.
• Track Improvement: Beat a replay, then save or replace your attempt.
• Ghost Customization: Change or hide your ghost cursor.
• Free Practice & Racing: Replays up to 45 seconds or 75 words. Pro removes both limits.
• Import Replays: Import recordings to watch, practice, or race when compatible.

Multiplayer Mode:
• Real-Time Matches: Compete in 60-second English typing challenges w

show_hn.title: Show HN: ClickClack – an offline Mac/iOS typing test with deep stats iCloud Sync

quotes.text:
ClickClack is a native SwiftUI typing-practice app that runs entirely offline, stores data locally with SwiftData, and (optionally) syncs through the user’s private CloudKit container, so nothing ever touches a third-party server. It measures net/gross WPM, accuracy, consistency, and generates heat-maps of mistyped keys. You can run timed drills (15 s – 5 min) or word-count drills (15 – 500 words), paste any text you like, and see progress graphs built with SwiftCharts.

Why I built it:

Most typing tests live in the browser and require an account. I wanted something that:

1. works offline (plane, train, spotty Wi-Fi)

2. respects privacy (data stays local or in the user’s iCloud)

3. feels native on Mac, iPad, and iPhone (single SwiftUI codebase)

Technical bits:

• UI / logic: SwiftUI.

• Persistence: SwiftData + CloudKit private DB.

• Charts: SwiftCharts for WPM / accuracy graphs.

• Haptics & audio: native APIs with switch / typewriter sound profiles.

• Keymap overlay: live map for QWERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, Workman.

• Key heat-map: per-character error counters rendered as a color grid.
